therapists.name: Nicky Wildin
therapists.excerpt: Cambridge-educated and BACP-registered member Nicky brings a warm approach and a depth of experience shaped by her extensive work in the relational and mental health sector, including partnerships with the NHS and educational settings.
content: Cambridge-educated and BACP-registered member Nicky brings a warm approach and a depth of experience shaped by her extensive work in the relational and mental health sector, including partnerships with the NHS and educational settings.

Nicky provides a safe, reflective, collaborative space grounded in trust, humour, and hope for a brighter future. She works to address challenges such as trust, bereavement, relationship difficulties, communication issues, infidelity, parenting struggles, intimacy issues, and personal growth. Her integrative approach incorporates Person-Centred therapy, CBT, Attachment Theory, and Narrative Therapy, tailored to meet each client’s unique needs.

therapists.name: Carlene Harvey
therapists.photo_alt: Carlene Harvey, Couples therapist at Leone Centre
therapists.excerpt: A highly experienced Couple, Individual and Systemic Therapist, BACP accredited, with over 20 years of therapeutic practice. She holds a Master of Education in Psychotherapeutic Counselling and a full specialism in Mentalisation-Based Therapy for Parenting Under Pressure (MBT-PP, Tavistock). Carlene is a trauma-informed therapist with experience in ADHD and neurodiversity, and extensive work with the RNIB, alongside her practice across the charity sector, NHS, and schools, with experience supporting individuals, couples and parents across a wide range of emotional and relational challenges. Her background as both Therapist and Clinical Supervisor reflects a deep understanding of the complexities of mental, relational, and neurodevelopmental health.
content: A highly experienced Couple, Individual and Systemic Therapist, BACP accredited, with over 20 years of therapeutic practice. She holds a Master of Education in Psychotherapeutic Counselling and a full specialism in Mentalisation-Based Therapy for Parenting Under Pressure (MBT-PP, Tavistock). Carlene is a trauma-informed therapist with experience in ADHD and neurodiversity, and extensive work with the RNIB, alongside her practice across the charity sector, NHS, and schools, with experience supporting individuals, couples and parents across a wide range of emotional and relational challenges. Her background as both Therapist and Clinical Supervisor reflects a deep understanding of the complexities of mental, relational, and neurodevelopmental health.

Carlene’s therapeutic style blends warmth, insight, and integrity, offering guidance that empowers clients to rewrite their stories, reconnect with themselves, and rebuild relationships with authenticity and understanding. She specialises in supporting parents, couples, and individuals to create healthier, more fulfilling emotional lives, with sensitivity to neurodiversity and sensory difference. Additional training in relationship breakdown and separation further informs her work with individuals and couples navigating separation, changing relationship dynamics, parenting after separation and co-parenting.
Offering online appointments.

therapists.name: Holly Roberts
therapists.photo_alt: Holly Roberts, Leone Centre Family and Relationship Therapist
therapists.excerpt: Holly Roberts is a BACP Registered Integrative Therapist with over 12 years of experience supporting individuals and couples through some of life’s most complex emotional and relationship challenges. Whether clients are navigating trauma, attachment wounds, neurodivergence, fertility journeys, relationship difficulties, low self-worth or significant life transitions, Holly offers a calm, compassionate and thoughtful space where they can begin to make sense of their experiences.
content: Holly Roberts is a BACP Registered Integrative Therapist with over 12 years of experience supporting individuals and couples through some of life’s most complex emotional and relationship challenges. Whether clients are navigating trauma, attachment wounds, neurodivergence, fertility journeys, relationship difficulties, low self-worth or significant life transitions, Holly offers a calm, compassionate and thoughtful space where they can begin to make sense of their experiences.

Clients value Holly’s warm, steady presence and her ability to help them feel heard and understood without judgement. She believes meaningful change begins with feeling safe enough to explore the stories, patterns and relationships that have shaped us. Alongside gentle curiosity, Holly brings insight and practical understanding to help clients strengthen their relationships with themselves and others.

Holly’s integrative approach draws on attachment-informed, trauma-informed, psychodynamic, systemic, person-centred, relational and Compassion-Focused Therapy (CFT). She tailors therapy to each individual or couple, recognising that every person’s story is unique.

In 2022, Holly completed Compassionate Inquiry training with Dr. Gabor Maté, further deepening her work with trauma, attachment and emotional healing. She has particular experience helping clients understand how early experiences continue to shape present-day relationships and emotional wellbeing.

Holly also has extensive experience supporting people in polyamorous and ethically non-monogamous relationships, offering an inclusive, affirming space where clients can explore their relationships openly and without assumption.
Online appointments available.

therapists.name: Lucy Robertson-Ritchie
therapists.role: Individual, Couples and Family Systemic Psychotherapist
therapists.photo_alt: Lucy Robertson Ritchie - Leone Centre Therapist
therapists.excerpt: Lucy is one of the most experienced therapists around. Highly skilled Systemic and Family Psychotherapist, Supervisor, Trainer, and Lecturer with over 20 years of experience supporting individuals, couples, children, young people, and families across NHS, charity, educational, and private settings.
content: Lucy is one of the most experienced therapists around. Highly skilled Systemic and Family Psychotherapist, Supervisor, Trainer, and Lecturer with over 20 years of experience supporting individuals, couples, children, young people, and families across NHS, charity, educational, and private settings.

She works collaboratively and compassionately, drawing on systemic, trauma-informed, attachment-based, and relational approaches to help clients better understand their experiences, strengthen relationships, and navigate emotional and family challenges.

Lucy supports individuals, couples, parents, foster carers, adoptive families, and young people experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, self-harm, relationship difficulties, neurodiversity (ASD/ADHD), and family conflict. She has particular experience working with adoption, fostering, developmental trauma, and high-emotion family systems.
Lucy also integrates mindfulness approaches into her work where appropriate, supporting emotional regulation, safety, and wellbeing.
Offering online appointments.

therapists.name: Rasa Motiejune
therapists.photo_alt: Rasa Motiejune, therapist at Leone Centre
therapists.excerpt: Rasa is a highly experienced and sought-after Family and Couple Systemic Psychotherapist with over 15 years of experience across the NHS and private practice. Registered with the UKCP, Rasa draws on Systemic Psychotherapy, CBT (Cognitive Behavioural Therapy), DBT (Dialectical Behaviour Therapy), Trauma-Focused CBT and mindfulness, integrating these approaches to meet each client’s needs.
content: Rasa is a highly experienced and sought-after Family and Couple Systemic Psychotherapist with over 15 years of experience across the NHS and private practice. Registered with the UKCP, Rasa draws on Systemic Psychotherapy, CBT (Cognitive Behavioural Therapy), DBT (Dialectical Behaviour Therapy), Trauma-Focused CBT and mindfulness, integrating these approaches to meet each client’s needs.
Clients value her calm, thoughtful and compassionate approach, which helps them make sense of difficult experiences and move forward with greater clarity and confidence.

Rasa has particular interest and experience in supporting couples experiencing communication difficulties, conflict and disconnection. She also works with parents using a Non-Violent Resistance (NVR) approach to reduce conflict, strengthen relationships and respond to challenging behaviours with calm, confident leadership. Rasa supports individuals and families navigating life transitions and complex relationship dynamics, and has experience working with LGBTQ+ and neurodivergent clients, offering an affirming, inclusive approach where every identity and background is respected.

Warm, grounded and genuinely curious, Rasa believes every person’s story deserves to be understood in its full context. Whether working with relationship difficulties, family conflict, parenting challenges, trauma, anxiety or eating disorders, she helps clients recognise unhelpful patterns, strengthen resilience and build healthier ways of relating to themselves and others.
Rasa offers online therapy for couples, parents and families, helping them strengthen relationships, navigate challenges and create meaningful, lasting change.
Offering online appointments.

therapists.name: Lucy Watney
therapists.photo_alt: Lucy Watney - Couples and Family Therapist at Leone Centre
therapists.excerpt: With over 15 years of therapeutic experience, Lucy Watney is a highly sought-after Family and Systemic Psychotherapist, accredited by the UKCP and a professional member of the Association for Family Therapy and Systemic Practice. Lucy’s experience spans across the NHS, schools, and charities.
content: With over 15 years of therapeutic experience, Lucy Watney is a highly sought-after Family and Systemic Psychotherapist, accredited by the UKCP and a professional member of the Association for Family Therapy and Systemic Practice. Lucy’s experience spans across the NHS, schools, and charities.

Lucy is warm, perceptive and collaborative; she helps clients look beyond the immediate difficulty to understand the patterns, experiences and relationships that may be keeping them stuck. Lucy works with individuals, couples and families, supporting children, young people and parents through communication issues, conflict, relationship strain, neurodiversity and differences in parenting approaches.

Lucy uses emotional regulation techniques and body awareness, where appropriate, to help clients with conflict, stress, and communication issues, helping to support constructive and meaningful conversations.

Drawing on attachment theory, narrative therapy and solution-focused approaches, Lucy focuses therapy on each client’s needs and goals. Her earlier training as a Dance Movement Therapist adds a distinctive dimension to her work, bringing an awareness of how emotional experiences can also be held and expressed through the body.
Offering both in-person and face-to-face appointments in Fulham and Wimbledon.

therapists.name: Tonia Forster
therapists.photo_alt: Tonia Forster, Family and Couples Therapist at Leone Centre
therapists.excerpt: Tonia is a highly experienced UKCP and AFT registered Family Therapist and Supervisor of Therapists, with over 30 years of experience supporting individuals, couples, and families.
content: Tonia is a highly experienced UKCP and AFT registered Family Therapist and Supervisor of Therapists, with over 30 years of experience supporting individuals, couples, and families.

She works collaboratively and with warmth, drawing on systemic and relational approaches to help clients understand patterns, process lived experience, and develop practical, sustainable ways to manage life’s challenges.

Tonia works with couples facing relationship difficulties or seeking to rebuild trust, families experiencing tension, transitions, or emotional strain, and individuals wanting to understand relational patterns, manage anxiety or low mood, or process major life challenges. She also provides a reflective space for anyone looking to explore personal concerns or ideas in a supportive environment.

She helps clients address a wide range of issues, including communication difficulties, eating distress, family tensions, infidelity, parenting challenges, ASD/ADHD, and emotional concerns such as anxiety, depression, and trauma.
Offering online appointments.

therapists.name: Martina Bador
therapists.excerpt: With over 18 years of experience as a therapist, Martina is a registered professional member of both the BACP and COSRT, offering specialist support as an Individual, Couples, and Psychosexual Therapist. She has worked extensively with diverse clients, including LGBTQIA+ communities and older couples, bringing sensitivity, inclusivity, and deep understanding to her practice.
content: With over 18 years of experience as a therapist, Martina is a registered professional member of both the BACP and COSRT, offering specialist support as an Individual, Couples, and Psychosexual Therapist. She has worked extensively with diverse clients, including LGBTQIA+ communities and older couples, bringing sensitivity, inclusivity, and deep understanding to her practice.

Known for her warm, approachable, and deeply relational style, she creates a safe, non-judgmental space where clients feel heard, supported, and empowered. She specialises in relationship therapy, helping individuals and couples who are experiencing challenges such as communication difficulties, affairs and infidelity, intimacy concerns, and emotional disconnection.

Her expertise also extends to physical and sexual health, mental wellbeing, menopause and perimenopause, as well as anxiety and depression. She integrates clinical knowledge with genuine human connection, supporting meaningful and lasting change.
Online therapy appointments are available, offering flexible and accessible support

therapists.name: Cristina Lorefice
therapists.excerpt: Inspirational and highly experienced Individual and Couples Therapist, BACP accredited, with over 15 years’ professional practice. Highly experienced in Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT) and Solution-Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT). Cristina is also a motivational speaker, interviewer, author, and a seasoned clinical practitioner.
content: Inspirational and highly experienced Individual and Couples Therapist, BACP accredited, with over 15 years’ professional practice. Highly experienced in Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT) and Solution-Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT). Cristina is also a motivational speaker, interviewer, author, and a seasoned clinical practitioner.

Cristina has worked within a wide range of professional settings across the UK, USA, Italy, Austria, and Nigeria. She is widely respected for her thoughtful, compassionate, and insightful approach, supporting clients with relationship challenges, loss of connection and intimacy, communication difficulties, cheating and infidelity, depression and low mood, anxiety, eating disorders, anger management, divorce, and separation. Cristina skilfully holds space for clients’ lived experiences while gently guiding them towards meaningful growth and change.
Her integrative, adaptable, and sensitive approach combines deep therapeutic exploration with practical, solution-oriented coaching.
Online sessions available in English and Italian.

therapists.name: Susan Harris
therapists.photo_alt: Susan Harris, Couples and Family therapist at Leone Centre
therapists.excerpt: Susan Harris is a highly experienced Family and Couple Systemic Psychotherapist with over 30 years’ experience working across the NHS and social care. Susan Harris is UKCP-registered and trained in a range of evidence-based systemic and attachment-based approaches, including Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) and Narrative Therapy.
content: Susan Harris is a highly experienced Family and Couple Systemic Psychotherapist with over 30 years’ experience working across the NHS and social care. Susan Harris is UKCP-registered and trained in a range of evidence-based systemic and attachment-based approaches, including Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) and Narrative Therapy.

She holds an MSc in Family and Systemic Psychotherapy and an Externship in Emotionally Focused Couples Therapy, with additional qualifications from King’s College London, The Tavistock Clinic, and University College London.

Susan’s style is collaborative, warm, and reflective. She works with couples and families to improve communication and strengthen relationships. She has particular expertise in perinatal and postnatal mental health, relationship difficulties, anxiety and low mood, neurodiversity, and gender identity questioning.
Experienced in working with heterosexual and same-sex couples, and affirming of diverse cultural, gender and sexual identities.
Susan offers couples’ and family therapy in person in Fulham, Belgravia and online.

content: With over 20 years of experience and a warm, grounded relational style, Valerie is an MBACP- and COSRT-accredited Psychosexual and Relationship Therapist, EMDR Practitioner, Addiction Counsellor, and Clinical Supervisor. She works with individuals and couples experiencing sexual issues, relationship challenges, and the emotional impact of trauma, infidelity, or compulsive sexual behaviours.

Valerie’s work is integrative and responsive, drawing on Humanistic, Psychodynamic, Systemic, and Trauma-Focused approaches. She offers a thoughtful, non-judgemental space to explore sexual wellbeing, intimacy, emotional connection, and self-worth. With specialist training in psychosexual therapy, sex addiction, and EMDR, she supports clients in understanding the roots of their difficulties and moving towards healthier, more fulfilling relationships.
Offering online appointments.

content: William is a highly experienced Integrative Therapist with over 18 years of experience, known for his warm, knowledgeable, understanding and relatable approach. therapists.name: Stelios Christodoulou
therapists.excerpt: Stelios is one of the most experienced therapists around, bringing over 25 years of rich and well-developed clinical and supervisory practice to his work.
content: Stelios is one of the most experienced therapists around, bringing over 25 years of rich and well-developed clinical and supervisory practice to his work.

A BACP-registered Counsellor and Psychotherapist trained in Gestalt and Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), he supports individuals and couples facing infidelity, emotional disconnection, grief, anxiety, addiction, depression and “quiet quitting” of relationships. With relational depth and practical insight, Stelios also works with workplace conflict, career strain and the challenges faced by expatriates.

Stelios brings a rare combination of clinical precision and intuitive quality to his work. Skilled in working with high-conflict dynamics, emotional disconnection and the deeper patterns that sit beneath surface issues, he supports clients in developing clearer communication, stronger boundaries and more secure relational bonds. His ability to hold complex emotional landscapes with steadiness and insight makes him a trusted therapist for individuals and couples seeking meaningful change.
Offering both in-person and online sessions, he provides flexible support shaped around each client’s unique context.

content: With over 20 years of experience, Olena is a BACP-registered counselling practitioner (BPsych MA CSAccred) and clinical supervisor, working with individuals, couples, thruples and other relationship constellations.

Working within the neuro-, gender, sexual and relationship diversity affirming framework, Olena’s approach is personalised, drawing from her extensive training in varied therapeutic modalities.
Offering online appointments.

content: As an Advanced Individual and Couples Therapist Supervisor, Practice Lead, Clinical Consultant, and therapist writer, Louanne is a highly experienced relational therapist with over 15 years of practice.

As a member of the British Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (BACP), she has an extensive background in supporting clients with a variety of challenges, including communication issues, the impact of parenting, relationships affected by infidelity, divorce, estrangement, bereavement, sexual abuse, eating disorders, self-harm, fertility issues, and addiction. Louanne also provides support for individuals facing illness and diagnosis-related challenges.
Offering online appointments.

content: Founder and Lead Consultant of Leone Centre’s Corporate and Consultancy Services, Alison brings specialist experience in work culture, relational intelligence. content: Founder and director of Leone Centre, Cristina Vrech, has 20+ years of experience in working and supporting people, 14+ years of extensive experience as a therapist and offers valuable knowledge to individuals and couples. Prior to being a therapist, she worked in the financial sector.
